# Exported and imported generic bodies accept selected package-state layouts.
[!isolates] skip
go build ./...
go build -gcflags=example.org/generic/...=-d=isolatepackages=example.org/generic:example.org/generic/use ./...

-- go.mod --
module example.org/generic
go 1.26
-- state.go --
package generic
var epoch int
func SetEpoch[T ~int](value T){epoch=int(value)}
type Counter[T ~int] struct{Value T}
func(c *Counter[T])Set(value T){c.Value=value}
-- use/use.go --
package use
import "example.org/generic"
func Apply(){
 generic.SetEpoch(42)
 var counter generic.Counter[int]
 counter.Set(7)
}
